subject: Economics
title: India's Path: Democracy, Diversity, and a Billion Dreams
description: A fast breakdown of India's Path: Democracy, Diversity, and a Billion Dreams for builders.

hook.text: India's Path: one economic idea can change how an entire system behaves.

buildup.text: India's economy was stagnant until 1991 liberalization.

discovery.text: India leapfrogged manufacturing (mostly) and built a services-powered economy.

twist.text: But India's growth skipped the majority. Manufacturing never absorbed the masses. 45% still work in agriculture.

climax.text: India's Path matters because incentives shape behavior at every scale.

punchline.text: India proves you can grow fast without dictatorship.

quiz.question: How does India's development path differ from China's?
options: India focused on services rather than manufacturing and developed democratically rather than under authoritarian rule — but with more uneven results
India and China followed identical paths
